name: mutant-census
description: The workspace's quality layer, executed: the burial record's historical defects COMPILED into nine mutation operators (each re-enacting a real error class, provenance on the row), replayed against the shared kernel family and its standard compositions, and KILLED one by one by a ten-property battery that holds for every seeded input (dual-path arithmetic, negative controls, statistical kills labeled DATA-grade). Mutation testing (DEM78, JIA11) and property-based testing (CLA00) are established fields; the claim here is the COUPLING — and, since 0.3.0, the CLOSED LOOP: the burial record is imported LIVE on every run and EVERY error it carries is enrolled to the guard that kills it now (107 on live mutants via a declared-class tie, 61 on build gates anchored file+needle to disk, 36 booked unenforceable with printed reasons) — an error without an enforcement anchor cannot be buried. The kernel family's byte-identity across every repo is censused live (unregistered drift fails the build), the repos' engineering hygiene is machine-swept with zero tolerated unguarded entries, and one command (`npm run total`) judges the whole workspace's tests AND typechecks. Survivors would be declared SURVIVED and booked as blind spots — a silent survivor is a hidden one.
